en.title: Brazil election goes to run-off as right-wing Flávio Bolsonaro wins first round
en.summary: Brazil's presidential election will proceed to a second round on 25 October after no candidate secured over 50% of votes in the first round.

stories.title: Flávio Bolsonaro takes lead in first round of Brazil election

en.title: Flávio Bolsonaro takes lead in first round of Brazil election
en.summary: Flávio Bolsonaro, son of the jailed former far-right president, has unexpectedly taken the lead in Brazil's first election round against incumbent leftist President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva.

en.title: Brazil's presidential race goes to second round as Flávio Bolsonaro leads incumbent Lula
en.summary: Far-right candidate Flávio Bolsonaro garnered 47% of votes while incumbent Lula received 45.1%, forcing a runoff scheduled for 25 October.
